title: Deductwise — state-correct security deposit statement for small landlords
oneLiner: For self-managing landlords with 1–10 units, it turns a move-out into a prorated, state-rule-checked itemized deposit statement with an evidence bundle before the deadline that can cost them 2–3x the deposit.
overlaps: none close in the portfolio; nearest are covercheck (HOA vendor insurance) and ownerbrief (property-manager owner letters, passed) — different user and moment
